label: FSS (Organic Foods) Regulations, 2017
authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
source_note: Applies only when the product is presented as organic (is_organic). Reg 5(1) makes organic-status information mandatory and the FSSAI (Jaivik Bharat) organic logo the baseline mark; a NPOP/PGS-India certification mark 'may' additionally be carried, so it is modelled as advisory (minor, optional). Whether the product is genuinely certified under NPOP/PGS-India cannot be verified from a photo — see the reference standard.

checks.message: An organic food must convey full and accurate organic-status information, e.g. the certification system (NPOP / PGS-India / Jaivik Bharat) or 'certified organic'.
An organic food should display the FSSAI organic (Jaivik Bharat) logo.
The product may additionally carry a NPOP or PGS-India certification / quality-assurance mark.

reference_standards.label: NPOP / PGS-India system compliance
reference_standards.note: Organic food must actually comply with all provisions of NPOP or PGS-India (production, traceability to producer level, valid certification / transaction certificate). This is a supply-chain fact that cannot be verified from the label image — confirm the certificate with the accredited certification body.
